# get_pore_dia_lattice { #mofography.compute.get_pore_dia_lattice }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> Lattice-method LCD/PLD/DFSD for comparison; stores results under pore_dia_lattice. Use `get_pore_dia_mgr_winding` instead.

```python
compute.get_pore_dia_lattice(
    mat_atoms,
    dgrid=None,
    results=None,
    variant='v2',
    kwargs=None,
)
```

Lattice pore diameters; stores ``pore_dia_lattice`` on *results* when provided.
